_claim_run_lock.name: Take the run lock
_claim_run_lock.what: Only in a scheduled run: it skips itself when another run is live.

_check_retry_evidence.name: Check retry evidence
_check_retry_evidence.what: Decides whether an earlier failed run can be resumed.

_update_repository.name: Update the repository
_update_repository.what: Pulls the latest state. Never resets or force-pushes.

_start_operation.name: Start the operation
_start_operation.what: Binds this run to one operation id and date.

_check_toolchain.name: Check the toolchain
_check_toolchain.what: Confirms the Codex CLI and the search adapter answer. Sends one tiny test request to the model.

_start_kirkus_pass.name: Start the Kirkus pass
_start_kirkus_pass.what: Reads the coming-soon listing in the background, with a long pause between requests.

_run_pm_pass.name: PM pass
_run_pm_pass.what: Reads new deal emails and parses each deal.

_run_pw_pass.name: PW pass
_run_pw_pass.what: Fetches the issue PDF and parses the reviews.

_capture.name: Capture source pages
_capture.what: Fetches every configured source and proves each page is the declared one. A changed layout fails the source.

_extract_main_batch.name: Extract books from pages
_extract_main_batch.what: The model (`{{extraction_model}}`) reads each captured page and returns book rows: title, author, publisher. Code checks provenance and retries within a budget.

_join_kirkus_pass.name: Join the Kirkus pass
_join_kirkus_pass.what: Waits for the background pass and takes its result.

_record_source_processing.name: Record source processing
_record_source_processing.what: Notes per source what was read and what failed.

_finalize.name: Finalize extraction
_finalize.what: Turns accepted extractions into one replay config.

_run_pipeline.name: Run the pipeline
_run_pipeline.what: Groups mentions into one book, checks eligibility, Russian edition and visible risk, sets the priority label, applies editor feedback and hard rules, hides rejected books without a material change.

_complete_isbns.name: Complete ISBNs
_complete_isbns.what: Fills a missing ISBN from the source link, the captured page, the book page, or Open Library.

_enrich_descriptions.name: Write grounded descriptions
_enrich_descriptions.what: Code searches through the adapter, fetches pages and checks they are about this book. The model (`{{description_model}}`) writes the Russian description from that evidence. Code screens the text.

_adjudicate_descriptions.name: Adjudicate descriptions
_adjudicate_descriptions.what: The model decides one thing: does this page really describe this book? Code verifies the citations.

_write_pm_logline_descriptions.name: PM logline descriptions
_write_pm_logline_descriptions.what: The model restates the deal's one-sentence logline in Russian, adding nothing.

_complete_original_editions.name: Find original editions
_complete_original_editions.what: The model proposes the original title of a translation. Open Library must confirm it.

_complete_work_age.name: Record the age of the work
_complete_work_age.what: Looks up the first publication year and edition count in Open Library, so an old book on a new list does not read as new. A translation takes the age of its original.

_refresh_after_descriptions.name: Refresh after descriptions
_refresh_after_descriptions.what: Re-runs risk screening and profile rules on the new text.

_score_editorial_fit.name: Score editorial fit
_score_editorial_fit.what: Jev scores each book of the run, then the undecided books of earlier runs. Detail in the Jev section below.

_render_review.name: Render the review
_render_review.what: Builds the HTML review with its tabs, reads the newest score of each book and orders the books by it.

_record_source_failure_streaks.name: Record source failure streaks
_record_source_failure_streaks.what: Counts failed nights in a row per source, so a broken source stands out from one bad night.

_check_health.name: Check run health
_check_health.what: Validates the artifacts against each other.

_record_completion_facts.name: Record completion facts
_record_completion_facts.what: New, updated, description coverage, source problems.

_decide_outcome.name: Decide the outcome
_decide_outcome.what: Complete, or attention needed, by fixed rules.

_export_state.name: Export state
_export_state.what: Writes the SQLite state out as sharded JSON.

_scan_artifacts_for_secrets.name: Scan artifacts for secrets
_scan_artifacts_for_secrets.what: Blocks publication if a key leaked into output.

_open_review.name: Open the review
_open_review.what: Only in a run started by hand; the server has no screen.

_finalize_repository.name: Finalize the repository
_finalize_repository.what: Commits and pushes the state files.

questions.text: How well does the book suit a publisher of popular nonfiction for a wide audience?
questions.note: Jev returns a probability per level. Code takes the average level: that is the score the review shows.

questions.text: Who is the book written for?
How well known is the author, judging only from the supplied facts?

rows.name: Build the input
rows.what: A strict allowlist of public book facts: title, authors, descriptions, source signals. Editor decisions, notes, priority and the taste profile are never sent.

rows.name: Ask Jev
rows.what: One request per book, model `{{jev_model}}`, three closed questions. {{jev_workers}} parallel workers, {{jev_budget}} s for the whole stage.

rows.name: Validate and combine
rows.what: Rejects a malformed answer or a different model. Turns the probabilities into the fit level and the composite by a fixed formula.

rows.name: Record
rows.what: Writes one score file for the run and one for the undecided older books. No state file changes; a failure never stops the run.

rows.name: Show and order
rows.what: The review reads each book's newest score. With `editorial_fit_ordering` on, books of one date go highest first, unscored after them, priority D last.

rows.name: Compare with the editor
rows.what: Offline and read-only: how well each ordering separates approved from rejected books, and a pass or fail benchmark on held-out runs.

rows.name: Editor feedback
rows.what: The agent finds the exact book, runs the preview, and asks one question in Russian.

rows.name: … preview and write
rows.what: The preview changes nothing. The write needs `--confirmed-by-editor`.

rows.name: Taste profile
rows.what: Hard rules hide books; soft preferences nudge the order.

rows.name: Merge duplicate books
rows.what: Computes the full merge plan as a dry run; the agent explains it and asks.

rows.name: Doctor
rows.what: Read-only diagnosis of a blocked run, plus repair and recovery on request.

rows.name: Night source scouting
rows.what: Searches the web, picks candidate sources, judges novelty, writes a morning report.

rows.name: … probe and onboard
rows.what: Bounded fetch of a proposed URL, policy check, scaffold, transaction.

rows.name: Model qualification
rows.what: A fixed test harness that measures a model before it is pinned.

rows.name: Development
rows.what: The agent implements issues; `scripts/check` gates the merge.

rows.name: State Store
rows.what: The one place canonical state is read and written: SQLite, exported as sharded JSON. Candidate History lives here.

rows.name: Config
rows.what: Sources, switches, and the model pin.

rows.name: Model door
rows.what: Runs `codex exec` in a read-only sandbox for every stage that needs the pinned model.

rows.name: Search adapter
rows.what: A loopback HTTP service on the run server that holds the search key.

rows.name: Code gate
rows.what: The server runs `scripts/check` on new code before a scheduled run uses it.

rows.name: Tests
rows.what: Fixture runs must be byte-identical.
